verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֣ת מִנְּשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ הַ֠נְּבִיאִים צָעֲקָ֨ה אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁ֜ע לֵאמֹ֗ר עַבְדְּךָ֤ אִישִׁי֙ מֵ֔ת וְאַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּ֣י עַבְדְּךָ֔ הָיָ֥ה יָרֵ֖א אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהַ֨נֹּשֶׁ֔ה בָּ֗א לָקַ֜חַת אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֧י יְלָדַ֛י ל֖וֹ לַעֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’iš·šāh ’a·ḥaṯ min·nə·šê ḇə·nê- han·nə·ḇî·’îm ṣā·‘ă·qāh ’el- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ lê·mōr ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’î·šî mêṯ wə·’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā kî ‘aḇ·də·ḵā hā·yāh yā·rê ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·han·nō·šeh bā lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- šə·nê yə·lā·ḏay lōw la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Now the wife . . . of one of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha . . . Your servant my husband is dead and you know that your servant feared the LORD And now his creditor is coming to take my two children as his slaves
verses.literalPt: E UMA mulher, das mulheres dos filhos dos profetas, clamou a Eliseu, dizendo: Meu marido, teu servo, morreu; e tu sabes que o teu servo temia ao SENHOR; e veio o credor, para levar os meus dois filhos para serem servos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤יהָ אֱלִישָׁע֙ מָ֣ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֔ךְ הַגִּ֣ידִי לִ֔י מַה־ יֶּשׁ־ לְכִי בַּבָּ֑יִת וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֣ין לְשִׁפְחָתְךָ֥ כֹל֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם־ אָס֥וּךְ שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ hag·gî·ḏî lî mah- yeš- lə·ḵī bab·bā·yiṯ wat·tō·mer ’ên lə·šip̄·ḥā·ṯə·ḵā ḵōl bab·ba·yiṯ kî ’im- ’ā·sūḵ šā·men
verses.literal: How can I help you asked Elisha . . . Tell me what do you have . . . in the house She answered Your servant has nothing . . . in the house but a jar of oil
verses.literalPt: E Eliseu lhe disse: Que te hei de fazer? Dize-me que é o que tens em casa. E ela disse: Tua serva não tem nada em casa, senão uma botija de azeite.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְכִ֨י שַׁאֲלִי־ לָ֤ךְ כֵּלִים֙ מִן־ הַח֔וּץ מֵאֵ֖ת כָּל־ שִׁכְנָכֵי כֵּלִ֥ים רֵקִ֖ים אַל־ תַּמְעִֽיטִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·ḵî ša·’ă·lî- lāḵ kê·lîm min- ha·ḥūṣ mê·’êṯ kāl- šiḵ·nå̄·ḵē kê·lîm rê·qîm ’al- tam·‘î·ṭî
verses.literal: Go said Elisha borrow - empty jars from all your neighbors Do not gather just a few
verses.literalPt: Então disse ele: Vai, pede emprestadas, de todos os teus vizinhos, vasilhas vazias, não poucas.

verses.original: וּבָ֗את וְסָגַ֤רְתְּ הַדֶּ֙לֶת֙ בַּעֲדֵ֣ךְ וּבְעַד־ בָּנַ֔יִךְ וְיָצַ֕קְתְּ עַ֥ל כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְהַמָּלֵ֖א תַּסִּֽיעִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇāṯ wə·sā·ḡart had·de·leṯ ba·‘ă·ḏêḵ ū·ḇə·‘aḏ- bā·na·yiḵ wə·yā·ṣaqt ‘al kāl- hak·kê·lîm hā·’êl·leh wə·ham·mā·lê tas·sî·‘î
verses.literal: Then go inside shut the door behind you and your sons and pour oil into all these jars setting the full ones aside
verses.literalPt: Então entra, e fecha a porta sobre ti, e sobre teus filhos, e deita o azeite em todas aquelas vasilhas, e põe à parte a que estiver cheia.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ מֵֽאִתּ֔וֹ וַתִּסְגֹּ֣ר הַדֶּ֔לֶת בַּעֲדָ֖הּ וּבְעַ֣ד בָּנֶ֑יהָ הֵ֛ם מַגִּשִׁ֥ים אֵלֶ֖יהָ וְהִ֥יא מֵיצָקֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ mê·’it·tōw wat·tis·gōr had·de·leṯ ba·‘ă·ḏāh ū·ḇə·‘aḏ bā·ne·hā hêm mag·gi·šîm ’ê·le·hā wə·hî mē·ṣå̄·qɛṯ
verses.literal: So she left him and after she had shut the door behind her and her sons they kept bringing jars to her and she kept pouring
verses.literalPt: Partiu, pois, dele, e fechou a porta sobre si e sobre seus filhos; e eles lhe traziam as vasilhas, e ela as enchia.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כִּמְלֹ֣את הַכֵּלִ֗ים וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ בְּנָהּ֙ הַגִּ֨ישָׁה אֵלַ֥י עוֹד֙ כֶּ֔לִי וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד כֶּ֑לִי וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד הַשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kim·lōṯ hak·kê·lîm wat·tō·mer ’el- bə·nāh hag·gî·šāh ’ê·lay ‘ō·wḏ ke·lî way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā ’ên ‘ō·wḏ ke·lî way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ haš·šā·men
verses.literal: When all the jars were full she said to her son Bring me . . . another . . . But he replied . . . There are no more jars Then the oil stopped flowing
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, cheias que foram as vasilhas, disse a seu filho: Traze-me ainda uma vasilha. Porém ele lhe disse: Não há mais vasilha alguma. Então o azeite parou.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֗א וַתַּגֵּד֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְכִי֙ מִכְרִ֣י אֶת־ הַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְשַׁלְּמִ֖י אֶת־ נִשְׁיֵכִי וְאַ֣תְּ בְּנֵיכִי תִֽחְיִ֖י בַּנּוֹתָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō wat·tag·gêḏ lə·’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer lə·ḵî miḵ·rî ’eṯ- haš·še·men wə·šal·lə·mî ’eṯ- niš·yē·ḵī wə·’at bə·nē·ḵī ṯiḥ·yî ban·nō·w·ṯār
verses.literal: She went and told the man of God and he said Go sell the oil and pay your debt Then you and your sons can live on the remainder
verses.literalPt: Então veio ela, e o fez saber ao homem de Deus; e disse ele: Vai, vende o azeite, e paga a tua dívida; e tu e teus filhos vivei do resto.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י הַיּ֜וֹם וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ר אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אֶל־ שׁוּנֵ֗ם וְשָׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַתַּחֲזֶק־ בּ֖וֹ לֶאֱכָל־ לָ֑חֶם וַֽיְהִי֙ מִדֵּ֣י עָבְר֔וֹ יָסֻ֥ר שָׁ֖מָּה לֶאֱכָל־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ’el- šū·nêm wə·šām ’iš·šāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh wat·ta·ḥă·zeq- bōw le·’ĕ·ḵāl- lā·ḥem way·hî mid·dê ‘ā·ḇə·rōw yā·sur šām·māh le·’ĕ·ḵāl- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: One day Elisha went to Shunem and a prominent woman who lived there persuaded him to have a meal . . . So whenever . . . he would pass by he would stop there to eat . . .
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu também um dia que, indo Eliseu a Suném, havia ali uma mulher importante, a qual o reteve para comer pão; e sucedeu que todas as vezes que passava por ali entrava para comer pão.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אִישָׁ֔הּ הִנֵּה־ נָ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קָד֣וֹשׁ ה֑וּא עֹבֵ֥ר עָלֵ֖ינוּ תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’el- ’î·šāh hin·nêh- nā yā·ḏa‘·tî kî ’îš ’ĕ·lō·hîm qā·ḏō·wōš hū ‘ō·ḇêr ‘ā·lê·nū tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Then the woman said to her husband Behold now I know that the one who often comes our way . . . is a holy man of God
verses.literalPt: E ela disse a seu marido: Eis que tenho observado que este que sempre passa por nós é um santo homem de Deus.

verses.original: נַֽעֲשֶׂה־ נָּ֤א עֲלִיַּת־ קִיר֙ קְטַנָּ֔ה וְנָשִׂ֨ים ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛ם מִטָּ֥ה וְשֻׁלְחָ֖ן וְכִסֵּ֣א וּמְנוֹרָ֑ה וְהָיָ֛ה בְּבֹא֥וֹ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ יָס֥וּר שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: na·‘ă·śeh- nā ‘ă·lî·yaṯ- qîr qə·ṭan·nāh wə·nā·śîm lōw šām miṭ·ṭāh wə·šul·ḥān wə·ḵis·sê ū·mə·nō·w·rāh wə·hā·yāh bə·ḇō·’ōw ’ê·lê·nū yā·sūr šām·māh
verses.literal: Please let us make a small room upstairs . . . and put in it a bed a table a chair and a lamp for him Then when he comes to us he can stay there
verses.literalPt: Façamos-lhe, pois, um pequeno quarto junto ao muro, e ali lhe ponhamos uma cama, uma mesa, uma cadeira e um candeeiro; e há de ser que, vindo ele a nós, para ali se recolherá.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם וַיָּ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּה וַיָּ֥סַר אֶל־ הָעֲלִיָּ֖ה וַיִּשְׁכַּב־ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm way·yā·ḇō šām·māh way·yā·sar ’el- hā·‘ă·lî·yāh way·yiš·kaḇ- šām·māh
verses.literal: One day Elisha came to visit . . . and went to his upper room to lie down . . .
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que um dia ele chegou ali, e recolheu-se àquele quarto, e se deitou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ גֵּחֲזִ֣י נַעֲר֔וֹ קְרָ֖א לַשּׁוּנַמִּ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את וַיִּקְרָא־ לָ֔הּ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- gê·ḥă·zî na·‘ă·rōw qə·rā laš·šū·nam·mîṯ haz·zōṯ way·yiq·rā- lāh wat·ta·‘ă·mōḏ lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: And he said to Gehazi his servant Call the Shunammite woman And when he had called her she stood before him
verses.literalPt: Então disse ao seu servo Geazi: Chama esta sunamita. E chamando-a ele, ela se pôs diante dele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אֱמָר־ נָ֣א אֵלֶיהָ֮ הִנֵּ֣ה חָרַ֣דְתְּ׀ אֵלֵינוּ֮ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַחֲרָדָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֒ מֶ֚ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֔ךְ הֲיֵ֤שׁ לְדַבֶּר־ לָךְ֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ א֖וֹ אֶל־ שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֑א וַתֹּ֕אמֶר בְּת֥וֹךְ עַמִּ֖י אָנֹכִ֥י יֹשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ’ĕ·mār- nā ’ê·le·hā hin·nêh ḥā·raḏt ’ê·lê·nū ’eṯ- kāl- ha·ḥă·rā·ḏāh haz·zōṯ meh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lāḵ hă·yêš lə·ḏab·ber- lāḵ ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’ōw ’el- śar haṣ·ṣā·ḇā wat·tō·mer bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·mî ’ā·nō·ḵî yō·šā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: and Elisha said to Gehazi Now tell her Look you have gone to all this trouble . . . for us What can we do for you . . . Can we speak on your behalf to the king or the commander of the army I have a home among my own people she replied
verses.literalPt: Porque ele tinha falado a Geazi: Dize-lhe: Eis que tu nos tens tratado com todo o desvelo; que se há de fazer por ti? Haverá alguma coisa de que se fale por ti ao rei, ou ao capitão do exército? E disse ela: Eu habito no meio do meu povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר וּמֶ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֑הּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּיחֲזִ֗י אֲבָ֛ל בֵּ֥ן אֵֽין־ לָ֖הּ וְאִישָׁ֥הּ זָקֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ū·meh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lāh way·yō·mer gê·ḥă·zî ’ă·ḇāl bên ’ên- lāh wə·’î·šāh zā·qên
verses.literal: So he asked Then what should be done for her Well she has no son Gehazi replied and her husband is old
verses.literalPt: Então disse ele: Que se há de fazer por ela? E Geazi disse: Ora ela não tem filho, e seu marido é velho.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר קְרָא־ לָ֑הּ וַיִּקְרָא־ לָ֔הּ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד בַּפָּֽתַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qə·rā- lāh way·yiq·rā- lāh wat·ta·‘ă·mōḏ bap·pā·ṯaḥ
verses.literal: Call her said Elisha So Gehazi called her and she stood in the doorway
verses.literalPt: Por isso disse ele: Chama-a. E, chamando-a ele, ela se pôs à porta.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לַמּוֹעֵ֤ד הַזֶּה֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה אַתִּי חֹבֶ֣קֶת בֵּ֑ן וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אַל־ אֲדֹנִי֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אַל־ תְּכַזֵּ֖ב בְּשִׁפְחָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lam·mō·w·‘êḏ haz·zeh kā·‘êṯ ḥay·yāh ʾat·tī ḥō·ḇe·qeṯ bên wat·tō·mer ’al- ’ă·ḏō·nî ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’al- tə·ḵaz·zêḇ bə·šip̄·ḥā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: And Elisha declared At this time next year . . . you will hold a son in your arms No my lord she said Do not lie to your maidservant O man of God
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: A este tempo determinado, segundo o tempo da vida, abraçarás um filho. E disse ela: Não, meu SENHOR, homem de Deus, não mintas à tua serva.

verses.original: וַתַּ֥הַר הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן לַמּוֹעֵ֤ד הַזֶּה֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יהָ אֱלִישָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har hā·’iš·šāh wat·tê·leḏ bên lam·mō·w·‘êḏ haz·zeh kā·‘êṯ ḥay·yāh ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’ê·le·hā ’ĕ·lî·šā‘
verses.literal: But the woman did conceive and at that time the next year . . . she gave birth to a son just as Elisha had told her
verses.literalPt: E concebeu a mulher, e deu à luz um filho, no tempo determinado, no ano seguinte, segundo Eliseu lhe dissera.

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל הַיָּ֑לֶד וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיֵּצֵ֥א אֶל־ אָבִ֖יו אֶל־ הַקֹּצְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·dal hay·yā·leḏ way·hî hay·yō·wm way·yê·ṣê ’el- ’ā·ḇîw ’el- haq·qō·ṣə·rîm
verses.literal: And the child grew and one day he went out to his father who was with the harvesters
verses.literalPt: E, crescendo o filho, sucedeu que um dia saiu para ter com seu pai, que estava com os segadores,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ אָבִ֖יו רֹאשִׁ֣י׀ רֹאשִׁ֑י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הַנַּ֔עַר שָׂאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־ אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- ’ā·ḇîw rō·šî rō·šî way·yō·mer ’el- han·na·‘ar śā·’ê·hū ’el- ’im·mōw
verses.literal: My head My head he complained to his father So his father told a servant Carry him . . . to his mother
verses.literalPt: E disse a seu pai: Ai, a minha cabeça! Ai, a minha cabeça! Então disse a um moço: Leva-o à sua mãe.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂאֵ֔הוּ וַיְבִיאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־ אִמּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֧שֶׁב עַל־ בִּרְכֶּ֛יהָ עַד־ הַֽצָּהֳרַ֖יִם וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā·’ê·hū way·ḇî·’ê·hū ’el- ’im·mōw way·yê·šeḇ ‘al- bir·ke·hā ‘aḏ- haṣ·ṣā·ho·ra·yim way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: After the servant had picked him up and carried him to his mother the boy sat on her lap until noon and then he died
verses.literalPt: E ele o tomou, e o levou à sua mãe; e esteve sobre os seus joelhos até ao meio dia, e morreu.

verses.original: וַתַּ֙עַל֙ וַתַּשְׁכִּבֵ֔הוּ עַל־ מִטַּ֖ת אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתִּסְגֹּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וַתֵּצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘al wat·taš·ki·ḇê·hū ‘al- miṭ·ṭaṯ ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tis·gōr ba·‘ă·ḏōw wat·tê·ṣê
verses.literal: And she went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God Then she shut the door . . . and went out
verses.literalPt: E subiu ela, e o deitou sobre a cama do homem de Deus; e fechou a porta, e saiu.

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָא֮ אֶל־ אִישָׁהּ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁלְחָ֨ה נָ֥א לִי֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וְאַחַ֖ת הָאֲתֹנ֑וֹת וְאָר֛וּצָה עַד־ אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאָשֽׁוּבָה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā ’el- ’î·šāh wat·tō·mer šil·ḥāh nā lî ’e·ḥāḏ min- han·nə·‘ā·rîm wə·’a·ḥaṯ hā·’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ wə·’ā·rū·ṣāh ‘aḏ- ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’ā·šū·ḇāh
verses.literal: And the woman called . . . her husband and said Please send me one of the servants and one of the donkeys that I may go quickly to the man of God and return
verses.literalPt: E chamou a seu marido, e disse: Manda-me já um dos moços, e uma das jumentas, para que eu corra ao homem de Deus, e volte.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מַ֠דּוּעַ אַתִּי הֹלַכְתִּי אֵלָיו֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹֽא־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וְלֹ֣א שַׁבָּ֑ת וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mad·dū·a‘ ʾat·tī hō·laḵ·tī ’ê·lāw hay·yō·wm lō- ḥō·ḏeš wə·lō šab·bāṯ wat·tō·mer šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Why would you go to him today he replied It is not a New Moon or a Sabbath Everything is all right she said
verses.literalPt: E disse ele: Por que vais a ele hoje? Não é lua nova nem sábado. E ela disse: Tudo vai bem.

verses.original: וַֽתַּחֲבֹשׁ֙ הָֽאָת֔וֹן וַתֹּ֥אמֶר אֶֽל־ נַעֲרָ֖הּ נְהַ֣ג וָלֵ֑ךְ אַל־ תַּעֲצָר־ לִ֣י לִרְכֹּ֔ב כִּ֖י אִם־ אָמַ֥רְתִּי לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·ḥă·ḇōš hā·’ā·ṯō·wn wat·tō·mer ’el- na·‘ă·rāh nə·haḡ wā·lêḵ ’al- ta·‘ă·ṣār- lî lir·kōḇ kî ’im- ’ā·mar·tî lāḵ
verses.literal: Then she saddled the donkey and told . . . her servant Drive onward do not slow the pace for me unless I tell you
verses.literalPt: Então albardou a jumenta, e disse ao seu servo: Guia e anda, e não te detenhas no caminhar, senão quando eu to disser.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֗לֶךְ וַתָּב֛וֹא אֶל־ אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ הַ֣ר הַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וַ֠יְהִי כִּרְא֨וֹת אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים אֹתָהּ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ גֵּיחֲזִ֣י נַעֲר֔וֹ הִנֵּ֖ה הַשּׁוּנַמִּ֥ית הַלָּֽז׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ wat·tā·ḇō·w ’el- ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- har hak·kar·mel way·hî kir·’ō·wṯ ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ō·ṯāh min·ne·ḡeḏ way·yō·mer ’el- gê·ḥă·zî na·‘ă·rōw hin·nêh haš·šū·nam·mîṯ hal·lāz
verses.literal: So she set out and went to the man of God at Mount Carmel . . . When the man of God saw her at a distance he said to his servant Gehazi Look there is the Shunammite woman
verses.literalPt: Partiu ela, pois, e foi ao homem de Deus, ao monte Carmelo; e sucedeu que, vendo-a o homem de Deus de longe, disse a Geazi, seu servo: Eis aí a sunamita.

verses.original: עַתָּה֮ רֽוּץ־ נָ֣א לִקְרָאתָהּ֒ וֶאֱמָר־ לָ֗הּ הֲשָׁל֥וֹם לָ֛ךְ הֲשָׁל֥וֹם לְאִישֵׁ֖ךְ הֲשָׁל֣וֹם לַיָּ֑לֶד וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh rūṣ- nā liq·rā·ṯāh we·’ĕ·mār- lāh hă·šā·lō·wm lāḵ hă·šā·lō·wm lə·’î·šêḵ hă·šā·lō·wm lay·yā·leḏ wat·tō·mer šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Please run out now to meet her and ask Are you all right . . . Is your husband all right Is your child all right And she answered Everything is all right
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, corre-lhe ao encontro e dize-lhe: Vai bem contigo? Vai bem com teu marido? Vai bem com teu filho? E ela disse: Vai bem.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֞א אֶל־ אִ֤ישׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ הָהָ֔ר וַֽתַּחֲזֵ֖ק בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ גֵּֽיחֲזִ֜י לְהָדְפָ֗הּ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אִ֨ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים הַרְפֵּֽה־ לָהּ֙ כִּֽי־ נַפְשָׁ֣הּ מָֽרָה־ לָ֔הּ וַֽיהוָה֙ הֶעְלִ֣ים מִמֶּ֔נִּי וְלֹ֥א הִגִּ֖יד לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō ’el- ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- hā·hār wat·ta·ḥă·zêq bə·raḡ·lāw way·yig·gaš gê·ḥă·zî lə·hā·ḏə·p̄āh way·yō·mer ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm har·pêh- lāh kî- nap̄·šāh mā·rāh- lāh Yah·weh he‘·lîm mim·men·nî wə·lō hig·gîḏ lî
verses.literal: When she reached . . . the man of God at the mountain she clung to his feet Gehazi came over to push her away but the man of God said Leave her alone . . . for her soul is in deep distress and the LORD has hidden it from me and has not told me
verses.literalPt: Chegando ela, pois, ao homem de Deus, ao monte, pegou nos seus pés; mas chegou Geazi para retirá-la; disse porém o homem de Deus: Deixa-a, porque a sua alma está triste de amargura, e o SENHOR me encobriu, e não me manifestou.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר הֲשָׁאַ֥לְתִּי בֵ֖ן מֵאֵ֣ת אֲדֹנִ֑י הֲלֹ֣א אָמַ֔רְתִּי לֹ֥א תַשְׁלֶ֖ה אֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hă·šā·’al·tî ḇên mê·’êṯ ’ă·ḏō·nî hă·lō ’ā·mar·tî lō ṯaš·leh ’ō·ṯî
verses.literal: Then she said Did I ask you for a son . . . my lord Didn’t I say Do not deceive me
verses.literalPt: E disse ela: Pedi eu a meu SENHOR algum filho? Não disse eu: Não me enganes?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְגֵיחֲזִ֜י חֲגֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֗יךָ וְקַ֨ח מִשְׁעַנְתִּ֣י בְיָדְךָ֮ וָלֵךְ֒ כִּֽי־ תִמְצָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א תְבָרְכֶ֔נּוּ וְכִֽי־ יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א תַעֲנֶנּ֑וּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ מִשְׁעַנְתִּ֖י עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַנָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·ḡê·ḥă·zî ḥă·ḡōr mā·ṯə·ne·ḵā wə·qaḥ miš·‘an·tî ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā wā·lêḵ kî- ṯim·ṣā ’îš lō ṯə·ḇā·rə·ḵen·nū wə·ḵî- yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā ’îš lō ṯa·‘ă·nen·nū wə·śam·tā miš·‘an·tî ‘al- pə·nê han·nā·‘ar
verses.literal: So Elisha said to Gehazi Tie up your garment take my staff in your hand and go If you meet anyone do not greet him and if anyone greets you do not answer him Then lay my staff on the boy’s face
verses.literalPt: E ele disse a Geazi: Cinge os teus lombos, toma o meu bordão na tua mão, e vai; se encontrares alguém não o saúdes, e se alguém te saudar, não lhe respondas; e põe o meu bordão sobre o rosto do menino.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ם הַנַּ֔עַר חַי־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־ אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’êm han·na·‘ar ḥay- Yah·weh wə·ḥê- nap̄·šə·ḵā ’im- ’e·‘ez·ḇe·kā way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥă·re·hā
verses.literal: And the mother of the boy said As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live I will not leave you So he got up and followed her
verses.literalPt: Porém disse a mãe do menino: Vive o SENHOR, e vive a tua alma, que não te hei de deixar. Então ele se levantou, e a seguiu.

verses.original: וְגֵחֲזִ֞י עָבַ֣ר לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁעֶ֙נֶת֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַנַּ֔עַר וְאֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל וְאֵ֣ין קָ֑שֶׁב וַיָּ֤שָׁב לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֣וֹ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א הֵקִ֖יץ הַנָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡê·ḥă·zî ‘ā·ḇar lip̄·nê·hem way·yā·śem ’eṯ- ham·miš·‘e·neṯ ‘al- pə·nê han·na·‘ar wə·’ên qō·wl wə·’ên qā·šeḇ way·yā·šāḇ liq·rā·ṯōw way·yag·geḏ- lōw lê·mōr lō hê·qîṣ han·nā·‘ar
verses.literal: Gehazi went on ahead of them and laid the staff on the boy’s face but there was no sound or response So he went back to meet Elisha and told him . . . The boy has not awakened
verses.literalPt: E Geazi passou adiante deles, e pôs o bordão sobre o rosto do menino; porém não havia nele voz nem sentido; e voltou a encontrar-se com ele, e lhe trouxe aviso, dizendo: O menino não despertou.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֱלִישָׁ֖ע הַבָּ֑יְתָה וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנַּ֙עַר֙ מֵ֔ת מֻשְׁכָּ֖ב עַל־ מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ hab·bā·yə·ṯāh wə·hin·nêh han·na·‘ar mêṯ muš·kāḇ ‘al- miṭ·ṭā·ṯōw
verses.literal: When Elisha reached the house there was the boy lying dead on his bed
verses.literalPt: E, chegando Eliseu àquela casa, eis que o menino jazia morto sobre a sua cama.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר הַדֶּ֖לֶת בְּעַ֣ד שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō way·yis·gōr had·de·leṯ bə·‘aḏ šə·nê·hem way·yiṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: So he went in closed the door behind the two of them and prayed to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então entrou ele, e fechou a porta sobre eles ambos, e orou ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַל וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עַל־ הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַיָּשֶׂם֩ פִּ֨יו עַל־ פִּ֜יו וְעֵינָ֤יו עַל־ עֵינָיו֙ וְכַפָּ֣יו עַל־ כַּפּוֹ וַיִּגְהַ֖ר עָלָ֑יו וַיָּ֖חָם בְּשַׂ֥ר הַיָּֽלֶד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al way·yiš·kaḇ ‘al- hay·ye·leḏ way·yā·śem pîw ‘al- pîw wə·‘ê·nāw ‘al- ‘ê·nāw wə·ḵap·pāw ‘al- kap·pō way·yiḡ·har ‘ā·lāw way·yā·ḥām bə·śar hay·yā·leḏ
verses.literal: Then Elisha got on the bed and lay on the boy mouth to mouth eye to eye and hand to hand As he stretched himself out over him the boy’s body became warm
verses.literalPt: E subiu à cama e deitou-se sobre o menino, e, pondo a sua boca sobre a boca dele, e os seus olhos sobre os olhos dele, e as suas mãos sobre as mãos dele, se estendeu sobre ele; e a carne do menino aqueceu.

verses.original: וַיָּ֜שָׁב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ בַּבַּ֗יִת אַחַ֥ת הֵ֙נָּה֙ וְאַחַ֣ת הֵ֔נָּה וַיַּ֖עַל וַיִּגְהַ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וַיְזוֹרֵ֤ר הַנַּ֙עַר֙ עַד־ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים וַיִּפְקַ֥ח הַנַּ֖עַר אֶת־ עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ way·yê·leḵ bab·ba·yiṯ ’a·ḥaṯ hên·nāh wə·’a·ḥaṯ hên·nāh way·ya·‘al way·yiḡ·har ‘ā·lāw way·zō·w·rêr han·na·‘ar ‘aḏ- še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm way·yip̄·qaḥ han·na·‘ar ’eṯ- ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: Elisha turned away and paced back and forth . . . . . . . . . across the room Then he got on the bed and stretched himself out over the boy again and the boy . . . sneezed seven times and opened . . . his eyes
verses.literalPt: Depois desceu, e andou naquela casa de uma parte para a outra, e tornou a subir, e se estendeu sobre ele, então o menino espirrou sete vezes, e abriu os olhos.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֶל־ גֵּיחֲזִ֗י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ קְרָא֙ אֶל־ הַשֻּׁנַמִּ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וַיִּקְרָאֶ֖הָ וַתָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑יו וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שְׂאִ֥י בְנֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’el- gê·ḥă·zî way·yō·mer qə·rā ’el- haš·šu·nam·mîṯ haz·zōṯ way·yiq·rā·’e·hā wat·tā·ḇō·w ’ê·lāw way·yō·mer śə·’î ḇə·nêḵ
verses.literal: Elisha summoned . . . Gehazi and said Call the Shunammite woman So he called her . . . and she came . . . Then Elisha said Pick up your son
verses.literalPt: Então chamou a Geazi, e disse: Chama esta sunamita. E chamou-a, e veio a ele. E disse ele: Toma o teu filho.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹא֙ וַתִּפֹּ֣ל עַל־ רַגְלָ֔יו וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָ֑רְצָה וַתִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ בְּנָ֖הּ וַתֵּצֵֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō wat·tip·pōl ‘al- raḡ·lāw wat·tiš·ta·ḥū ’ā·rə·ṣāh wat·tiś·śā ’eṯ- bə·nāh wat·tê·ṣê
verses.literal: She came in fell at his feet and bowed to the ground Then she picked up her son and went out
verses.literalPt: E entrou ela, e se prostrou a seus pés, e se inclinou à terra; e tomou o seu filho e saiu.

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁ֞ע שָׁ֤ב הַגִּלְגָּ֙לָה֙ וְהָרָעָ֣ב בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּבְנֵי֙ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים יֹשְׁבִ֖ים לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְנַעֲר֗וֹ שְׁפֹת֙ הַסִּ֣יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּבַשֵּׁ֥ל נָזִ֖יד לִבְנֵ֥י הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·šā‘ šāḇ hag·gil·gā·lāh wə·hā·rā·‘āḇ bā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇə·nê han·nə·ḇî·’îm yō·šə·ḇîm lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yō·mer lə·na·‘ă·rōw šə·p̄ōṯ has·sîr hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ū·ḇaš·šêl nā·zîḏ liḇ·nê han·nə·ḇî·’îm
verses.literal: When Elisha returned to Gilgal there was a famine in the land As the sons of the prophets were sitting at his feet he said to his attendant Put on the large pot and boil some stew for the sons of the prophets
verses.literalPt: E, voltando Eliseu a Gilgal, havia fome naquela terra, e os filhos dos profetas estavam assentados na sua presença; e disse ao seu servo: Põe a panela grande ao lume, e faze um caldo de ervas para os filhos dos profetas.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א אֶחָ֣ד אֶל־ הַשָּׂדֶה֮ לְלַקֵּ֣ט אֹרֹת֒ וַיִּמְצָא֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שָׂדֶ֔ה וַיְלַקֵּ֥ט מִמֶּ֛נּוּ פַּקֻּעֹ֥ת שָׂדֶ֖ה מְלֹ֣א בִגְד֑וֹ וַיָּבֹ֗א וַיְפַלַּ֛ח אֶל־ סִ֥יר הַנָּזִ֖יד כִּֽי־ לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’e·ḥāḏ ’el- haś·śā·ḏeh lə·laq·qêṭ ’ō·rōṯ way·yim·ṣā ge·p̄en śā·ḏeh way·laq·qêṭ mim·men·nū paq·qu·‘ōṯ śā·ḏeh mə·lō ḇiḡ·ḏōw way·yā·ḇō way·p̄al·laḥ ’el- sîr han·nā·zîḏ kî- lō yā·ḏā·‘ū
verses.literal: One of them went out to the field to gather herbs and he found a wild vine from which he gathered as many wild . . . gourds as his garment could hold Then he came back and cut them up into the pot of stew though no one knew what they were
verses.literalPt: Então um deles saiu ao campo a apanhar ervas, e achou uma parra brava, e colheu dela enchendo a sua capa de colocíntidas; e veio, e as cortou na panela do caldo; porque não as conheciam.

verses.original: וַיִּֽצְק֥וּ לַאֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֶאֱכ֑וֹל וַ֠יְהִי כְּאָכְלָ֨ם מֵהַנָּזִ֜יד וְהֵ֣מָּה צָעָ֗קוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ מָ֤וֶת בַּסִּיר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·qū la·’ă·nā·šîm le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl way·hî kə·’ā·ḵə·lām mê·han·nā·zîḏ wə·hêm·māh ṣā·‘ā·qū way·yō·mə·rū mā·weṯ bas·sîr ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū le·’ĕ·ḵōl
verses.literal: And they poured it out for the men to eat . . . but when they tasted the stew they cried out . . . There is death in the pot O man of God And they could not . . . eat it
verses.literalPt: Assim deram de comer para os homens. E sucedeu que, comendo eles daquele caldo, clamaram e disseram: Homem de Deus, há morte na panela. Não puderam comer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ וּקְחוּ־ קֶ֔מַח וַיַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ אֶל־ הַסִּ֑יר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר צַ֤ק לָעָם֙ וְיֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְלֹ֥א הָיָ֛ה דָּבָ֥ר רָ֖ע בַּסִּֽיר׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ū·qə·ḥū- qe·maḥ way·yaš·lêḵ ’el- has·sîr way·yō·mer ṣaq lā·‘ām wə·yō·ḵê·lū wə·lō hā·yāh dā·ḇār rā‘ bas·sîr
verses.literal: Then Elisha said Get some flour He threw it into the pot and said Pour it out for the people to eat And there was nothing . . . harmful in the pot
verses.literalPt: Porém ele disse: Trazei farinha. E deitou-a na panela, e disse: Dai de comer ao povo. E já não havia mal nenhum na panela.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ בָּ֜א מִבַּ֣עַל שָׁלִ֗שָׁה וַיָּבֵא֩ לְאִ֨ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לֶ֤חֶם בִּכּוּרִים֙ עֶשְׂרִֽים־ לֶ֣חֶם שְׂעֹרִ֔ים וְכַרְמֶ֖ל בְּצִקְלֹנ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר תֵּ֥ן לָעָ֖ם וְיֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš bā mib·ba·‘al šā·li·šāh way·yā·ḇê lə·’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm le·ḥem bik·kū·rîm ‘eś·rîm- le·ḥem śə·‘ō·rîm wə·ḵar·mel bə·ṣiq·lō·nōw way·yō·mer tên lā·‘ām wə·yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Now a man from Baal-shalishah . . . came to the man of God with a sack of twenty loaves of barley bread from the first ripe grain Give it to the people to eat said Elisha
verses.literalPt: E um homem veio de Baal-Salisa, e trouxe ao homem de Deus pães das primícias, vinte pães de cevada, e espigas verdes na sua palha, e disse: Dá ao povo, para que coma.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ מָ֚ה אֶתֵּ֣ן זֶ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י מֵ֣אָה אִ֑ישׁ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר תֵּ֤ן לָעָם֙ וְיֹאכֵ֔לוּ כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אָכֹ֥ל וְהוֹתֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mə·šā·rə·ṯōw māh ’et·tên zeh lip̄·nê mê·’āh ’îš way·yō·mer tên lā·‘ām wə·yō·ḵê·lū kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ā·ḵōl wə·hō·w·ṯêr
verses.literal: But his servant asked How am I to set twenty loaves before a hundred men Give it to the people to eat said Elisha for this is what the LORD says They will eat and have some left over
verses.literalPt: Porém seu servo disse: Como hei de pôr isto diante de cem homens? E disse ele: Dá ao povo, para que coma; porque assim diz o SENHOR: Comerão, e sobejará.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן לִפְנֵיהֶ֛ם וַיֹּאכְל֥וּ וַיּוֹתִ֖רוּ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên lip̄·nê·hem way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yō·w·ṯi·rū kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over according to the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então lhos pôs diante, e comeram e ainda sobrou, conforme a palavra do SENHOR.
